desc:
As Sunsilk continues to open up possibilities for girls everywhere, we are calling all hair enthusiasts!
Sunsilk City gets a new exciting upgrade – Sunsilk Hair Care Lab - now live.

Master your entrepreneurial skills and build your own Sunsilk Hair Lab empire while maximising profit as you make upgrades to your business. Along the way, unlock various labs that allow you to customise your avatar with extreme hairstyles. Also see how quickly you can complete your tycoon before unlocking special boost cards!

🏢 Build your own hair care empire
🎓 Hire and train staff members
👩‍🦰 Unlock new hairstyles
🎨 Experiment with hair colours and shine effects
🔓 Unlock and upgrade boost cards to gain fun advantages
🏆 Earn badges
